verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird's VC practice page says it advises across the venture ecosystem, explicitly naming angel investors, equity and debt funds, and corporate investors. It also covers fund formation alongside company-side equity rounds and says the firm is "intimately familiar with market deal terms," and its TwoVenture hub serves both start-ups and their investors. Missing for 10: independent corroboration (all evidence is first-party marketing), recent deal-volume data (the only figure is from 2017), and explicit evidence of representing investors on specific deals rather than a general ecosystem claim.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the firm also represents venture funds and investors, so it knows current market terms from both sides of the table

citations.quote: including angel investors, equity and debt funds, corporate investors, incubators, accelerators and funding platforms

As one of few firms that advise on the complete spectrum of venture capital work – equity investments, growth or venture debt, fund formation and corporate venturing - we are intimately familiar with market deal terms, structures and trends
A hub to provide guidance to start-up and scale-up companies and their investors through the venture capital life cycle
well known to the leading investors in Asia and the US
